title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Job description
 
 About Us
 



 ARtrixx is a pioneering company at the forefront of AI innovation, dedicated to solving real\-world challenges through cutting\-edge machine learning solutions. We are passionate about delivering impactful and scalable AI\-driven applications across diverse industries.
 



 Job Description
 



 We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer to drive the development of advanced AI solutions. You will lead a team focused on large language models (LLM), prompt engineering, and computer vision, ensuring the delivery of scalable, high\-impact solutions. As a leader, you'll oversee technical direction, mentor engineers, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to align AI initiatives with business goals. Strong leadership, technical expertise, and a passion for innovation are essential.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Lead the design and deployment of AI solutions, focusing on LLM, prompt engineering, and computer vision.
* Guide the team in using frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face, and TensorFlow to build and optimize deep learning models.
* Architect scalable pipelines using technologies like FastAPI, Docker, and Postgres for model deployment and data handling.
* Oversee the development of multi\-threaded applications in Python, ensuring adherence to OOP principles.
* Drive the creation of computer vision models, including image processing tasks with OpenCV.
* Optimize and deploy machine learning workflows using tools like MLflow and Apache Airflow, ensuring smooth integration into production.
* Mentor the team in testing, evaluating, and fine\-tuning AI models to maximize performance and accuracy.
* Ensure seamless data handling and model deployment through libraries like Sklearn and Pandas.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to align AI initiatives with business objectives and operational goals.



 Preferred Qualifications
 


* 5\+ years of experience in AI engineering or a related field, with a focus on machine learning, AI models, and leadership.
* Expertise in Python, including advanced skills in multi\-threading, object\-oriented programming (OOP), and API design.
* Extensive experience with FastAPI, Docker, and deploying containerized applications at scale.
* Strong knowledge of database management and optimization, especially with Postgres and Python integration.
* Proficient in Linux environments and scripting for automation (e.g., Bash, Shell).
* Deep experience with large language models (LLM) and prompt engineering, including tools like CrewAI, LangGraph, vLLM, OpenAI, and Ollama.
* Expertise in fine\-tuning LLMs using techniques such as LoRA (Low\-Rank Adaptation), knowledge distillation, and prompt tuning for model efficiency and scalability.
* Advanced proficiency in deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face, and TensorFlow.
* Strong background in computer vision, including using OpenCV, CNNs, and advanced image processing techniques.
* Proven leadership experience, with the ability to mentor and guide a team of engineers.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills, with a strategic mindset.
* Experience in managing and optimizing AI workflows, from experimentation to deployment.
* Track record of delivering high\-impact AI solutions in startup or fast\-paced environments.



 Why Join Us?
 



 ✔ Lead transformative AI initiatives that will revolutionize industries globally.
 



 ✔ Collaborate with top\-tier talent in a dynamic, innovation\-driven environment.
 



 ✔ Attractive leadership compensation and comprehensive benefits package.
 



 As a Senior AI Engineer at
 
 ARtrixx
 
 , you will guide a team of experts to drive breakthrough AI solutions. Apply today to join ARtrixx and shape the future of AI. 🚀

description:
Are you passionate about shaping the future of AI and driving innovation in healthcare? A leading organization seeks a talented Senior AI Engineer to spearhead sophisticated machine learning initiatives that create real\-world impact. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced professional with a strong publication history and a drive to bridge the worlds of advanced tech research and practical business applications.
 



  










**About the role** 



* Lead the architecture, implementation, and optimization of cutting\-edge AI models, especially those tailored to healthcare and cross\-industry challenges
* Transform state\-of\-the\-art AI research into production\-ready solutions that address complex business problems
* Inspire and guide engineering teams, promote best practices, and mentor emerging talent in AI and machine learning
* Collaborate closely with senior stakeholders to ensure AI strategies align with key business goals and deliver quantifiable results
* Drive end\-to\-end ownership – from concept, data acquisition, and development to deployment and ongoing evaluation
* Continuously assess and introduce emerging technologies relevant to AI and healthcare transformation








  





**Candidate profile** 



* Minimum 4 years’ hands\-on experience delivering AI and machine learning solutions at scale
* Demonstrated track record of publishing in respected AI/ML journals or conferences
* Advanced technical skills in Python and frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch
* Deep grasp of algorithms, data structures and distributed systems
* Proven experience applying AI in practical healthcare settings
* Fluent in English, with ability to engage both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Participation in industry collaborations, patents, or speaking at international forums is highly regarded
* Masters or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or similar








  





**Why apply?** 




 This is a unique chance to take ownership of high\-impact AI initiatives, work on groundbreaking technology at the crossroads of research and real\-world application and make a difference in the healthcare sector.
 








  





**Recruitment process** 




 The role has recently opened so please apply within and once your application is reviewed you will be contacted if your profile meets the necessary requirements. The customer will conduct both online and face to face interviews based on candidate location and availability.
 







  





**Your consultant** 




 Michael Deane, Senior Recruitment Consultant with a focus on placing C\-Suite, VP \& Senior talent, along with Technical and Business Development professionals within Healthcare Technology across the Middle East region. Michael has an extensive technical, leadership and recruitment background.
 








  





**How to apply** 




 To be considered, please apply within including details of your publications and relevant AI project experience.

You bring strong experience in agent frameworks, orchestration of LLMs and AI services, and deploying scalable AI agents in production environments. Beyond advanced AI modeling skills, you excel at developing large\-scale, distributed data and agent pipelines, enabling interaction, autonomy, and coordination among agents, and integrating AI solutions into business\-critical workflows. * Lead the design, development, and deployment of agentic AI services, from PoC to production
* Architect and build agent flows, LLM orchestration, and multi\-agent systems leveraging frameworks such as LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Google\-ADK etc.
* Develop, evaluate, and optimize agent strategies for real\-world business challenges
* Collaborate with stakeholders to identify key opportunities for autonomous agent solutions across the organization
* Implement CI/CD, AgentOps pipelines for agent lifecycle management, monitoring, evaluation and continuous improvement using LLMJudge concepts and AgentOps frameworks such as MLFlow 3\.0, LangFuse, etc.
* Own the full lifecycle and operational excellence of deployed agentic AI systems
* Lead, inspire, and mentor junior engineers in the field of agent\-based AI development
* Stay at the forefront of emerging agentic AI frameworks, LLM APIs, and orchestration trends

* Bachelor’s or master’s in computer science, machine learning, engineering, or a closely related domain
* Advanced coding skills in Python (preferred) or Java, with expertise in agentic/LLM frameworks
* Experience with multi\-agent and LLM orchestration toolkits (e.g. LangChain, CrewAI, Haystack, AutoGen, etc.)

* Experience with SAP AI (e.g. AI Core, AI Business Services, Joule) and Scaled Agile (SAFe) is a plus

 Benefits

Our advanced automation streamlines the process of collecting overdue invoices for businesses, **providing a seamless and effective solution**.


At Murphy AI, we’re tackling one of the toughest challenges in fintech: **making debt recovery more efficient, autonomous and scalable.** Our AI\-powered agents adapt instantly, engaging with debtors across channels like voice, email and sms to maximize results while preserving trust. By combining advanced artificial intelligence with powerful automation, **we’re setting a new standard for how businesses recover payments**.


As a fast\-growing startup that has already made an impact within less than a year in the market, **we are building a talented team to scale our operations and drive our vision forward**  



  

#### **About the Role**


As a **Senior Backend Engineer**, you’ll build and scale the systems that power our **AI\-driven debt collection platform**.


You’ll work hand\-in\-hand with AI engineers and product owners to make our system effective, resilient under heavy load, and easy to visualize and control.


Along the way, you’ll mentor teammates, champion technical excellence, and apply the latest innovations and practices to keep Murphy ahead of the curve.

#### **Responsibilities**

* **Design, develop, and test backend solutions** that power our AI\-driven debt collection platform — ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability as we bring cutting\-edge AI into real\-world operations.
* **Implement highly scalable software architectures** (microservices, event\-driven systems, message queues) that allow us to handle thousands of communications every minute.
* Measure the impact of our system and **ruthlessly optimize it** to make it more effective and efficient.
* **Collaborate closely with AI engineers** to productionize their models, embedding intelligence directly into backend workflows and customer\-facing features.
* **Integrate with other services and vendors** with a strong focus on seamless interoperability and rock\-solid error handling.
* **Mentor and guide junior engineers**, sharing expertise in backend best practices and keeping a high bar for security and reliability.

#### **Requirements**

* **7\+ years as a software developer**, with a strong background in building backend services and distributed systems.
* Proven track record developing **scalable backend applications** in Python (Node.js and Typescript knowledge is a plus).
* Solid understanding of **microservice architectures**, event\-driven systems (Kafka or similar), and relational databases (PostgreSQL).
* Prior experience building systems that use AI or interact with it, in organizations or side projects.
* Familiarity with **cloud infrastructure** and container orchestration (Kubernetes, AWS/GCP) is a plus.
* Strong grasp of **observability practices**, including metrics, tracing, logging, and alerting, to ensure reliable and maintainable systems.
* Analytical mindset, proactive, self\-motivated, and able to make independent technical decisions.
* Strong collaboration and **mentoring experience** with junior developers.

#### **Our stack**

* **AI**: Python, OpenAI, 11Labs.
* **Backend**: Node.js, TypeScript, microservices, event\-driven architectures.
* **Infra**: Kubernetes, Postgres, Kafka, AWS.

#### **What we offer**


**Salary**: €60k–€80k gross/year


**Stock options**: Because we all build **Murphy together** – you'll own a piece of what we’re creating.


**Impact**: Be part of our startup journey from day one, playing a key role in our growth and building something meaningful from the ground up.


**Learning**: Continuous development through trainings, knowledge\-sharing, and exposure to other top\-tier startups in our ecosystem.


**Healthy meals**: No more boring tupperware – enjoy daily meals with **Nora Foods**. We cover 50% of each order!

‍️ **Ride into work:** Forget traffic jams – hop on your **Panot e\-bike** and cruise to the office! We cover 50% of your subscription.

**Hybrid \& Flexible**: Our default setup is hybrid – 3 days a week at our office in Poblenou, surrounded by a thriving tech scene, and 2 days of remote work. #### **Our Process**


We believe that hiring is a two\-way street: while we get to know you, you also deserve the chance to understand who we are, how we work, and what makes Murphy AI special. Here’s what you can expect:

A practical exercise to see how you approach challenges similar to those you’d tackle at Murphy. You’ll have time to reflect and showcase your thinking—no rush, no surprises.


4️⃣ **Coffee at the Office with the Founders**  

Finally, you’ll join us in our Barcelona office for a relaxed coffee with the founders and the Hiring Manager. It’s the perfect opportunity to experience our culture firsthand and meet more of the team who could soon be your colleagues.


To learn more about how we hire and what to expect at every step, feel free to explore our Hiring Guide!

We believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success, and we actively foster an environment where all voices are heard and respected.*

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:

One of the biggest challenges and opportunities with artificial intelligence is around the data used to train AI models, and how to do that responsibly and ethically whilst governing data protection, applying AI regulations, democratize knowledge and balance individual rights with societal benefits.


As a GenAI data engineer in Project Hafnia, you will be responsible for preparing the data and pipeline for advanced fine\-tuning of General\-purpose AI models and generate diverse, high\-fidelity synthetic visual data that can enhance computer vision model performance and coverage. Your capacity to bridge software engineering, prompt engineering, and data operations will be critical in using and scaling our data assets with the right quality and diversity. You will collaborate with a cross\-functional team to contribute to advanced annotations and training mechanisms, drive synthetic data generation, ensuring best practices and compliance with industry standards.


You will join our innovative and entrepreneurial development team at Milestone global leader in data\-driven video management solutions. Our mission is to build a suite of services surrounding a responsible data library as its core, leveraging compliant, high\-quality and ethically sourced video data. To achieve that, we follow our long\-term strategy, continuously scrutinize the emerging AI and stick to our ethical tech and responsible use of technology agenda.  



**Your owned perimeter:**

As a GenAI Data Engineer, you will be responsibilities and be the main point of reference for:


* Orchestrate general purpose AI model training, selecting and preparing data, while experimenting at scale on our infrastructure at the edge of innovation.
* Design and generate high\-quality synthetic data, taking into overwatching and experimenting with prompts and various video and image based scenarios.
* Gatekeep of data quality and diversity: develop methods to validate, test, and iterate on datasets to ensure they meet quality, standards and avoid unintended bias.
* Collaborate with our machine learning and computer vision experts to understand model limitations and identify data needs for the next use cases.
* Contribute to build and automate the data pipeline to scale the caption, generation and quality evaluation of our data.
Lead the generative AI data strategy, track, control and document the long\-term effects of data (real and synthetic) on computer vision models.  
* 

**Where skill meets impact!**

You might be the person we are looking for if you bring curiosity and craft and if you are passionate about data generation and have a deep understanding of prompt strategies. Key qualifications include:


**Dream Technical Skills:**

* Statistical data sense, capacity to analyze and crunch number to evaluate dataset distributions, detect anomalies and ensure diversity.
* Prompt engineering experts – ability to create and refine prompts for video GenAI with a creative and experimental mindset.
* Played around with Nvidia Metropolis or other vision AI application platform.
* Proficiency in Python to experiment and support the integrations of fine\-tuning architecture and automated synthetic data pipelines.
* Knowledge of machine learning to understand frameworks and AI training workflows.
Bonus for knowledge of ETLs or cloud \-based orchestration tools (e.g. Airflow).  
* 

**Expected Experience or Equivalent:**

* Hands\-on experience with data processing, generative AI tools or transformer models.
* Experience with synthetic data generation in a professional context where willingness to learn is es\-sential.
* Proven experience working within or next to an engineering team at the edge of technology
* Experience in data quality and assessment
Familiarity with responsible AI, bias mitigation and data protection best practices  
* 

**About project Hafnia and our team:**

You will join about 25 fantastic colleagues in a fast\-growing and broadly international team that besides the engineering core counts profiles across go\-to\-market, community, compliance, strategy and more. We operate as an autonomous product team and share an entrepreneurial mindset and a firm belief that we can cover new grounds to the benefit of the world. We work with trust, collaboration and flexibility as our foundations.  



**What else can Milestone offer you:**

In addition to the exciting challenges of this role, Milestone provides:


* Opportunities for professional growth and development.
* A supportive company culture and inclusive workplace environment.
* Daily meals, snacks, and beverages in our canteen.
* Office amenities such as company bikes, a gym, massages, and Friday gatherings.
Monthly company events for team bonding and enjoyment.  
* 

**Location, application and contact:**

Ideally, your base will be within regular travelling distance of our HQ in Copenhagen or our Madrid office but if you are the right profile, other options are possible.


We would like to receive your CV in English, avoid pictures; and cover letter won’t even be read. If you have any questions, you are very welcome to contact our Engineering Manager, Fulgencio Navarro (\+34 662024273\)


We would like you to start as soon as possible, and we will hire on an ongoing basis as we interview candidates.


Join us in shaping the future of video management through engineering and innovation. Let’s build products, services and your career in a meaningful way together  

  



**A few more info about Milestone \- help us make the world see:**

title: AI Cryptography Engineer
description:
**The Role**
 As an AI Engineer for Cryptographic ML Systems at Openchip, you will help design and implement the foundation of our privacy\-preserving, verifiable AI execution stack. This role brings together applied cryptography, secure ML inference, and low\-level systems development to ensure AI models deployed through AI OS can run safely, verifiably, and in privacy\-respecting environments. You will work across FHE (Fully Homomorphic Encryption), ZKML (Zero\-Knowledge Machine Learning), and circuit\-based proof systems like zkSNARKs to help develop and optimize the attestation and security algorithms running inside of Openchip’s AI OS. This role requires hands\-on implementation in Rust and Python, deep curiosity for math and cryptographic systems, and a collaborative mindset to work across research, engineering, and hardware teams. You will report directly to the Secure AI Optimization Lead and be a key driver in making secure AI practical, performant, and production ready.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement FHE\-based model inference workflows using Zama’s Concrete or similar libraries; evaluate performance and integration paths.
* Prototype and validate Zero\-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) pipelines for verifying model execution using tools such as ezkl, Circom, Halo2, and zkVMs.
* Contribute to the architecture and development of the Openchip’s composable framework for private/verifiable AI.
* Develop libraries in Rust and Python for compiling, executing, and verifying models in secure environments.
* Build and test APIs and servers for secure model inference and proof generation; explore design of PoC endpoints for real\-world integration.
* Integrate secure ML protocols with the broader Openchip AI OS runtime stack and interface with compiler/runtime teams as needed.
* Analyze performance implications and hardware\-software co\-design considerations when deploying cryptographically verified inference pipelines.
* Contribute to future proving scheme design tailored to Openchip’s custom AI hardware.


**Qualifications**
* MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Cryptography, Applied Mathematics, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* More than 5 years of experience or proficient in Rust (preferred) and Python, with experience developing secure or performance\-critical systems.
* Experience with at least one cryptographic proof system (zkSNARKs, Halo2, STARKs) and/or FHE frameworks (Concrete, SEAL, TFHE).
* Solid background in applied math or algorithm design related to cryptography, constraint systems, or polynomial arithmetic.
* Familiarity with secure inference and ML model verification concepts; interest in deploying models under trustless conditions.
* Comfortable with low\-level debugging and optimizing for compute/memory performance.


**Soft Skills**
* Passion for security, privacy, and trust in AI systems.
* Clear communicator who can work across research and engineering boundaries.
* Independent and exploratory, but thrives in a collaborative environment.
* Strong sense of code quality, modularity, and technical ownership.
* Curiosity\-driven mindset, excited to push the frontier of verifiable AI infrastructure.


**What We Offer**
* Join an innovative team and experience company growth.
* We believe in investing in our employees and providing them with opportunities for growth and career development.
* Work in a hybrid environment with flexible scheduling.
* We offer a remuneration package that values your experience. A chance to work on one of the most transformative AI and silicon engineering companies in Europe.
* The position will be preferably in Barcelona (Spain), but open to Gdansk (Poland), Rome (Italy) and Ghent (Belgium).


**We are looking for outstanding people willing to join our mission to change the silicon industry and help build a better world. If you feel identified with Openchip, please contact us.**

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
What if your next role let you shape the future of AI—and do it with empathy, responsibility, and real\-world impact? One of the biggest challenges and opportunities with artificial intelligence is around the data used to train AI models, and how to do that responsibly and ethically whilst governing data protection, applying AI regulations, democratize knowledge and balance individual rights with societal benefits.
 



  





 As a GenAI data engineer in Project Hafnia, you will be responsible for preparing the data and pipeline for advanced fine\-tuning of General\-purpose AI models and generate diverse, high\-fidelity synthetic visual data that can enhance computer vision model performance and coverage. Your capacity to bridge software engineering, prompt engineering, and data operations will be critical in using and scaling our data assets with the right quality and diversity. You will collaborate with a cross\-functional team to contribute to advanced annotations and training mechanisms, drive synthetic data generation, ensuring best practices and compliance with industry standards.
 



  





 You will join our innovative and entrepreneurial development team at Milestone global leader in data\-driven video management solutions. Our mission is to build a suite of services surrounding a responsible data library as its core, leveraging compliant, high\-quality and ethically sourced video data. To achieve that, we follow our long\-term strategy, continuously scrutinize the emerging AI and stick to our ethical tech and responsible use of technology agenda.
 



  





  





**Your owned perimeter:** 




  





 As a GenAI Data Engineer, you will be responsibilities and be the main point of reference for:
 



  




* Orchestrate general purpose AI model training, selecting and preparing data, while experimenting at scale on our infrastructure at the edge of innovation.
* Design and generate high\-quality synthetic data, taking into overwatching and experimenting with prompts and various video and image based scenarios.
* Gatekeep of data quality and diversity: develop methods to validate, test, and iterate on datasets to ensure they meet quality, standards and avoid unintended bias.
* Collaborate with our machine learning and computer vision experts to understand model limitations and identify data needs for the next use cases.
* Contribute to build and automate the data pipeline to scale the caption, generation and quality evaluation of our data.
* Lead the generative AI data strategy, track, control and document the long\-term effects of data (real and synthetic) on computer vision models.



  





  





**Where skill meets impact!** 




  





 You might be the person we are looking for if you bring curiosity and craft and if you are passionate about data generation and have a deep understanding of prompt strategies. Key qualifications include:
 



  





**Dream Technical Skills:** 




  




* Statistical data sense, capacity to analyze and crunch number to evaluate dataset distributions, detect anomalies and ensure diversity.
* Prompt engineering experts – ability to create and refine prompts for video GenAI with a creative and experimental mindset.
* Played around with Nvidia Metropolis or other vision AI application platform.
* Proficiency in Python to experiment and support the integrations of fine\-tuning architecture and automated synthetic data pipelines.
* Knowledge of machine learning to understand frameworks and AI training workflows.
* Bonus for knowledge of ETLs or cloud \-based orchestration tools (e.g. Airflow).



  





  





**Expected Experience or Equivalent:** 




  




* Hands\-on experience with data processing, generative AI tools or transformer models.
* Experience with synthetic data generation in a professional context where willingness to learn is essential.
* Proven experience working within or next to an engineering team at the edge of technology
* Experience in data quality and assessment
* Familiarity with responsible AI, bias mitigation and data protection best practices



  





  





**About project Hafnia and our team:** 




  





 You will join about 25 fantastic colleagues in a fast\-growing and broadly international team that besides the engineering core counts profiles across go\-to\-market, community, compliance, strategy and more. We operate as an autonomous product team and share an entrepreneurial mindset and a firm belief that we can cover new grounds to the benefit of the world. We work with trust, collaboration and flexibility as our foundations.
 



  





  





**What else can Milestone offer you:** 




  





 In addition to the exciting challenges of this role, Milestone provides:
 



  




* Opportunities for professional growth and development.
* A supportive company culture and inclusive workplace environment.
* Daily meals, snacks, and beverages in our canteen.
* Office amenities such as company bikes, a gym, massages, and Friday gatherings.
* Monthly company events for team bonding and enjoyment.



  





  





**Location, application and contact:** 




  





 Ideally, your base will be within regular travelling distance of our HQ in Copenhagen or our Madrid office but if you are the right profile, other options are possible.
 



  





 We would like to receive your CV in English, avoid pictures; and cover letter won’t even be read. If you have any questions, you are very welcome to contact our Engineering Manager, Fulgencio Navarro (\+34 662024273\)
 



  





 We would like you to start as soon as possible, and we will hire on an ongoing basis as we interview candidates.
 



  





 Join us in shaping the future of video management through engineering and innovation. Let’s build products, services and your career in a meaningful way together

 You will join Milestone, international company in rapid growth with development sites in Denmark, Bulgaria and Spain – and offices all over the world. title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
**About StackOne**
==================

*StackOne is the universal integration gateway for modern SaaS products and agents. We’ve raised $24m in 2 years, and we’re backed by top tier investors like Google Ventures and Workday Ventures.*

*StackOne sits behind the scenes as the integration layer providing thousands of tools,: SOC 2 compliant, multi\-tenant, and invisible to end users powering integrations for future\-of\-work SaaS categories such as HR, Compliance, and AI Agents.*

*Our customers are established B2B SaaS companies or small to enterprise companies building Agents to sell or to improve their own processes.*

**About the role**
------------------


We're building a world where users of any SaaS can integrate with the tool of their choice in one click thanks to StackOne. We're convinced AI is pivotal to making this a reality by transforming how SaaS talks to each other and this is what you will help achieve.


We are looking for a Software Engineer with a strong background in AI production\-grade applications with professional experience working with LLMs (eg: GPT, Anthropic and others).


In this role, you will deliver AI features and products end\-to\-end and work with the wider AI team of StackOne (comprising of AI researchers and other AI engineers). You will report directly to the CTO.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Act as a full\-stack web application engineering: **ideate, build, and ship** features across frontend, backend, data, and infrastructure.
* **Model data \& schemas** across SQL, document/columnar stores, and **OLAP**; design for correctness, performance, and cost.
* **Design and evolve public APIs** and standards: REST contracts, **OpenAPI**, pagination, auth, error models, plus **MCP/tool\-calling** conventions.
* **Engineer for scale and resilience**: rate limiting, retries, idempotency, back\-pressure, caching, SLIs/SLOs, and safe fallbacks.
* **Build and operate event systems** with Kafka\-class streaming patterns: producers/consumers, partitioning, DLQs, reprocessing, schema evolution.
* **Raise observability \& reliability**: tracing, metrics, logs, alerting, zero\-downtime deploys, runbooks.
* **Leverage LLMs/agents** to accelerate development while maintaining reliability, testing, and code quality.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* Proven experience as a **full\-stack** engineer shipping user\-facing, backend\-heavy systems.
* Expertise in **TypeScript** and solid experience with **React**; comfortable building clean UIs for complex backend capabilities.
* Strong background designing and operating **public APIs** and multi\-tenant systems.
* Experience with **distributed systems** concepts: streams, queues, idempotency, consistency, and performance trade\-offs.
* Ability to **think in systems** (throughput, tail latency, failure modes) and explain trade\-offs clearly.
* Curiosity and pragmatism with **LLMs/agents**: know when they help, and how to guardrail/evaluate them.
* Desire to work in a **fast\-paced startup**, take ownership end\-to\-end, and bias toward shipping.
* (Preferred) Experience publishing **CLIs \& SDKs** (internal or open\-source).

**️ Our Stack**
===============


Y**ou will have a lot of freedom and agency to chose and work with the technologies you love.** Our tech stack includes:

* **Infra \& monitoring:** AWS (ECS, RDS, Elasticache, Lambda etc.), Cloudflare, Tinybird, Modal, Dagster, Langsmith, Datadog, Sentry, Incident.io
* **Languages \& Frameworks**: Typescript (Node.js), Python, NestJS, React, Svelte,
* **Other day\-to\-day Tools:** Postman, Notion, Slack, Jira, Github and more

**Benefits**
------------

* *25 days holiday \+ 1 additional day holiday per year of tenure*
* *Participation in the company’s employee share options plan*
* *Private health insurance (including dental \& optical)*
* *Health, fitness and gift card discounts*
* *£1,000 for your home office set up \+ £500/year top\-up*
* *Paid lunch in the office*
* *Annual team offsite to sunny spots (last ones were in Spain and Portugal )*
* *Join one of Europe’s fastest\-growing startups*
* *Work with a veteran team of ex\-employees of Google, Microsoft, Oracle, Coinbase, JP Morgan and more*
* *Cycle2Work and Electric Cars scheme*
* *Hybrid work set up \- typically 2d in the office*


Ready to help us change the game for SaaS integrations? Get in touch and let's chat!

*We believe diversity drives innovation. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. As an equal\-opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

Summary:
Please note \- This program starts in July 2026  

  

VIAVI (NASDAQ: VIAV) is a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. VIAVI is also a leader in light management technologies for 3D sensing, anti\-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications.

Kick\-start your professional adventure in our R\&D Excellence Centers by joining multiple expert teams in an international rotation program. During this 2\-year program you’ll rotate through different teams, gain hands\-on experience, and contribute to real\-world projects that impact millions globally. The program is designed to accelerate your development, broaden your technical expertise, and help you discover your ideal career path.  

  

Once you complete this exciting program, you will continue your career within VIAVI collaborating with and contributing to your designated team.  

This rotational program offers early\-career engineers the opportunity to explore three specialised areas.  

  

* FPGA Engineering
* RF Engineering
* AI Engineering (Generative AI \& Data Science)


Duties \& Responsibilities:
Kick\-start your professional adventure in our R\&D Excellence Centers by joining multiple expert teams in an international rotation program. During this 2\-year program you’ll rotate through different teams, gain hands\-on experience, and contribute to real\-world projects that impact millions globally. The program is designed to accelerate your development, broaden your technical expertise, and help you discover your ideal career path.

This rotational program offers early\-career engineers the opportunity to explore three specialised areas.* FPGA Engineering
* RF Engineering
* AI Engineering (Generative AI \& Data Science)


What We’re Looking For!
We seek curious, collaborative, and driven individuals who are excited by innovation and eager to learn. If you thrive in agile environments and want to make a global impact through engineering excellence, VIAVI is the place for you. If you fit one of the below profiles, we would love to hear from you!
Pre\-Requisites / Skills / Experience Requirements:
FPGA Engineer
As an FPGA Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and developing FPGA applications focused on digital signal processing and communication protocols. You’ll create and execute test benches to validate performance and timing, while collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams including hardware, software, and systems engineers. Your role will involve optimizing designs for performance, power efficiency, and resource utilization, as well as debugging and troubleshooting complex FPGA implementations. Additionally, you’ll support the entire product lifecycle, from initial concept through to production deployment.
Required Qualifications:* Bachelor’s in Electrical/Computer/Optical Engineering or related field
* Proficiency in VHDL/Verilog and FPGA development tools
* Strong grasp of digital signal processing and timing analysis
* Experience with simulation and verification tools
* Familiarity with telecom/networking protocols
* Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills


RF Engineer
As an RF Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and testing RF circuits and systems used in telecom and network equipment. Your work will involve performing RF simulations and lab validations, including analysis of S\-parameters and noise figures. You’ll collaborate closely with hardware, software, and mechanical engineering teams to support product development and resolve technical issues. Additionally, you’ll document your designs and test procedures to ensure clarity and consistency throughout the development process.
Required Qualifications:* Bachelor’s in Electrical or RF/Microwave Engineering
* Solid understanding of RF fundamentals and electromagnetic theory
* Experience with RF test equipment and simulation tools
* High\-frequency PCB design experience
* Programming in MATLAB, Python
* Strong analytical and design skills


AI Engineer (Generative AI \& Data Science)
As a GenAI Engineer, you will research, prototype, and develop generative AI solutions tailored for telecom applications. Your work will involve leveraging large language models (LLMs) and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph to build intelligent, scalable systems. You’ll apply ethical and safe AI design principles while collaborating within agile teams to deliver innovative AI capabilities. The role also demands adaptability across a wide range of AI and data science challenges, ensuring solutions remain cutting\-edge and impactful.
Required Qualifications:* Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, or related field
* Strong Python skills and experience in AI/ML projects
* Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Hugging Face, etc.)
* Exposure to GenAI through projects, internships, or research
* Understanding of agentic AI concepts
* Experience with Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, SQL
* Knowledge of Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript


Come work with us, where we’ll celebrate your unique expertise, drive and passion. Learn more at http://www.viavisolutions.com/en and follow us on Viavi Perspectives, LinkedIn, Twitter, YouTube and Facebook.

title: Senior Full Stack AI/ML Engineer
description:
**️ We’re on a mission to change the football transfer market**

**TransferRoom** is a hyper\-growth B2B SaaS SportsTech company and the only digital marketplace in the world focusing on the global football industry.


We do this by empowering football clubs, agents and players to be successful in the transfer market by giving them real\-time market intelligence and direct access to a global network of decision\-makers.


TransferRoom has become a must\-have for key stakeholders in football’s transfer market. It’s used by 800\+ clubs, including **Man City**, **Liverpool** and **PSG**, 550 agencies and **8000 professional players**. It has empowered **clubs and agents** to facilitate over 6000 transfers since its launch in 2017\.

 **How We Work**


We work in **cross\-functional squads**, made up of full\-stack engineers, product managers, designers, analysts, and automated QAs. Together, these squads own a key area of our platform — from club tools and agent products to core infrastructure and data services.


We believe the best work happens when teams are empowered to make decisions, collaborate openly, and ship fast. Our squads are lean and can develop and deploy their products end\-to\-end autonomously. Our engineers pair program, do code reviews, and iterate quickly to keep learning and improving.


We practice Scrumban and deploy new features to our customers every two weeks or sooner.

 **️ Our Location**


Our London office is at **Bankside,** with additional tech teams in Poland and Ukraine.


Our office is naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Thursdays \& Fridays, when we have regular team drinks, celebrations and five\-a\-side football.

 **What You'll Be Working On**


As an AI engineer, you’ll drive and lead our innovation incubator function here at TransferRoom by rapidly developing, deploying and presenting AI/ML proof of concepts. Some of the technologies you’ll work with include:

* **C\# \& .NET**, **Python**, SQL for our core services
* **React** **\&** **React Native** for our front\-end and mobile apps
* **SQL Server****,** **MongoDB** **\&** **Databricks** for data storage, data processing and caching
* **AI \& ML** with a specific focus on the practical application of generative and agentic solutions for rapidly creating the next generation of innovative products
* **Azure** to run and scale our services
* **REST APIs** that connect it all


We hire for potential and mindset, not just a checklist of skills — so you don’t need to have used all these before. If you’re excited about solving problems at scale, we’ll support you with onboarding and learning opportunities to get up to speed.

 **You Should Apply If**

* You have 3\+ years of experience delivering production software with an emphasis on AI, data processing or MLOps
* You are skilled with version control tools like Git and Azure DevOps
* You have experience building data transformations on relational or non\-relational platforms
* You are comfortable working with cloud infrastructure, preferably Azure
* You thrive in working in an environment with rapid experimentation and innovation
* You can troubleshoot data workflows and optimise system performance
* You are familiar with C\#, Python, React, TypeScript and have experience with AI tools like ChatGPT, Azure AI or similar
* You have knowledge of data platforms like SQL Server, Power BI, BigQuery (preferred, not essential)
* You have experience delivering client\-facing software (preferred, not essential)

  

Not ticking every box? That’s okay! Research shows that underrepresented groups often self\-select out of applying unless they meet every single requirement. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you — even if you’re still growing into some of these skills.

 **The Interview Process**

  

We keep things simple and respectful of your time:



* **Screening Call** – meet our talent team and learn more about TransferRoom


* **Hiring Manager Call** \- to meet our leadership team


* **Technical Task** – show us how you solve problems


* **Final Stage Interview** – including system design, technical deep dive, and a values\-based conversation



We move quickly and work around your availability — our goal is to give you clarity at every step.

 **What’s in it for you**

  

* 
* Employee assistance programme
* 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
* Life insurance
* Critical illness
* Auto\-enrolment pension scheme with Hargreaves Lansdown, 3% employer contribution, collectively a minimum of 8%, with the option to contribute via salary sacrifice
* Enhanced parental leave
* Learning budget for everyone
* Discounted gym membership via Hussle
* A generous employee Referral Bonus scheme
* Team building days and events
* Cycle\-to\-work scheme and an annual travel season ticket loan
* ‘Matched Giving’ programme where we donate when our employees donate
* We are a unique combination of a scale up with security


We are a fast scaling, category creating company with smart teammates who love what they do. With a unique combination as a scale up with security, we have an 86% Employee Satisfaction Score, a Likelihood to Recommend score of 8\.3 and a score of 8\.8 for how our colleagues rate their relationships with their coworkers.

* Hands\-on experience with gradient\-boosted models (e.g., XGBoost, LightGBM) and/or building LLM\-powered systems (e.g. tool/function calling, prompt design, evals) for text\-heavy tasks.
* Solid data skills: SQL, pandas, experiment tracking, and cloud deployment (AWS a plus).

Competitive salary of £65,000 to £75,000 depending on experience

Hybrid working with one day a week from our dog\-friendly Hoxton office and on\-site gym


Comprehensive private medical \& dental cover with Vitality

Learning \& development culture – £500 personal annual budget


We’re carbon\-neutral and are working towards ambitious carbon reduction goals


Lots of team socials \& activities

* About us

* Xelix news
* Xelix glassdoor

title: Senior AI Engineer – Reinforcement Learning Lead
description:
**Ship AI\-generated code with confidence.** 




  





 Software is no longer written by humans alone , AI is generating code at scale, and traditional QA can’t keep up. Testing frameworks are collapsing under the weight of flaky scripts and endless regressions.
 



 Our vision: autonomous agents that think, explore, and learn like the best QA engineers , except they never sleep, never stall, and only get better with time.
 



  





 We’re backed by top VCs. Founded by operators from Meta and Uber. Customers are already asking for what we’re building. And now we’re hiring the person who will architect the brain that makes it possible.
 



  





 We don’t care about degrees or years. We care about clear signals of excellence: maybe you scaled a side project to thousands, maybe you crushed a FIDE rating. If you can deliver fast and at a high bar, we want to talk.
 



  





**Why This Role is Different** 




 Most “AI engineer” jobs are just applying models someone else built. This isn’t that. This is about pushing RL to its edge:
 



  




* Agents that think: networks that see and understand apps through vision, structure, and behavior.
* Agents that explore: curiosity\-driven RL that uncovers edge cases no human would think of.
* Agents that learn: smarter with every bug, sharper with every correction.
* Agents that scale: millions of states, thousands of sessions, decisions in sub\-seconds.



  





 If you’ve ever wanted to take RL out of papers and into the wild, this is it.
 



  





**What You’ll Achieve** 




 In your first three months, you’ll see your reinforcement learning prototypes running live inside real applications, surfacing bugs no human ever noticed.
 



 By six months, those agents will have evolved , scaling across multiple environments, learning and adapting in ways that prove this isn’t theory but reality.
 



 And within a year, the intelligence you’ve built will sit at the heart of every release for our first customers, powering their ability to ship AI\-generated code with confidence.
 



  





**What You Bring (** 
 Non\-Negotiables)
 


* 5\+ years shipping ML to production (real systems, not papers).
* Deep RL expertise , you think in Q\-values and policy gradients.
* Experience building autonomous agents that actually work at scale.
* Python/PyTorch mastery.



  





**The Stuff That Matters** 



* You’re obsessed with solving “impossible” problems.
* You’d rather ship and learn than debate in theory.
* You can explain RL to a CEO and optimize it for a GPU cluster.
* You thrive in chaos and see it as opportunity.



  





**Why Join Now** 



* **Impact:** 
 You won’t be “joining a team.” You’ll be the team that defines how software is built in the age of AI. Your code won’t sit in a corner , it will become the backbone of a new category.
* **Market:** 
 Software testing hasn’t changed in 30 years. AI\-generated code has rewritten the rules overnight. Whoever solves this bottleneck doesn’t just win a market , they reshape the entire industry.
* **Team:** 
 Small, elite, no passengers. You’ll be working side by side with a CTO who built this at Meta and a founding team that’s scaled some of the fastest\-growing tech companies on the planet.
* **Timing:** 
 Rarely do technology shifts and career timing line up. This is one of those moments. Five years from now, autonomous QA will be a given. Right now, it’s unsolved , and you could be the one who solves it.



  





**The Challenge** 




 Big tech tried to brute\-force this problem and hit a wall. Most startups never got past brittle scripts. The reason is simple: building true autonomy takes more than patching frameworks , it takes intelligence. That’s the path we’re on. Your system will need to:
 



  




* Navigate the chaos of modern web apps.
* Learn from sparse, delayed rewards.
* Balance exploration with validation.
* Transfer knowledge across completely different applications.



  





 It won’t be easy. That’s the point.
 



  





**What You Get** 



* Equity that actually moves the needle , not token options, but a real ownership stake in what could be the category\-defining AI company of the decade.
* Unlimited firepower , the hardware, compute, and resources you need to push RL further than anyone has before.
* A seat at the table, not a cog in the machine, you’ll be in the room where every decision is made, shaping both the product and the company.
* Speed over politics , a London base where execution beats process, every time.
* A shot at legacy , work that will outlive your CV, the kind of achievement you’ll still be talking about 20 years from now.



  





 To win the space, we’re looking for the best people in London, with 10/10 ambition and work ethic to join us and build a product people love.

title: AI Engineer (Prompt Engineering & Python)
description:
Synthflow AI is a **no\-code platform for deploying voice AI agents** that automate phone calls across contact center operations and business process outsourcing (BPO) at scale. We help mid\-market and enterprise companies manage routine calls to save teams time and resources.


Our agents have already delivered measurable impact:

* Over **5 million hours** of contact center operations saved
* **35% more calls** answered compared to non\-AI operators
* 45 million calls handled with a **99\.9% uptime**


Backed by **Accel, Atlantic Labs, and Singular** and trusted by over 1,000 customers, our growth leads an industry shift toward sophisticated and accessible conversational AI.

**The Role**
------------


We’re hiring an **AI Engineer** who lives and breathes **prompt engineering** and writes excellent **production\-grade Python**. You’ll run a tight feedback loop with customers, turn real conversations into better prompts and eval datasets, and ship changes that measurably improve agent outcomes. This is a highly applied role working directly with customer feedback.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Design \& iterate prompts** (system, tool/function\-calling, task prompts) to boost voice AI agent success, reliability, and tone.
* **Build co\-pilots for customers to author their own prompts**: meta\-prompted assistants that suggest structures, lint for risks, autocomplete tool schemas, critique drafts, and generate eval cases.
* Work **directly with customer feedback** and conversation logs to identify failure modes; translate them into prompt changes, guardrails, and data improvements.
* **Build eval datasets** (success labels, rubrics, edge cases, regressions) and run **offline/online evaluations** (A/B tests, canaries) to quantify impact.
* Create **Python utilities/services** for prompt versioning, config\-as\-code, rollout/rollback, and guardrails (policies, refusals, redaction).
* Partner with PM/Success to define **success metrics** (task completion, first\-pass accuracy, cost, latency) and instrument dashboards/alerts.
* Own LLM integration details: **function/tool schemas**, output parsing/validation (pydantic), retrieval\-aware prompting, and fallback strategies.
* Ensure **privacy \& compliance** (PII handling, anonymization, regional data boundaries) in datasets and logs.
* Share learnings via concise docs, playbooks, and internal demos.

**Must\-Have Skills**
---------------------

* **Python:** 3\+ years writing clean, tested, production code (typing, pytest, profiling); experience building small services/APIs (FastAPI preferred).
* **Prompt Engineering:** Hands\-on experience designing system/tool prompts, meta\-prompting, rubric graders, and iterative prompt tuning based on real user data.
* **LLM Integration:** Comfortable with major APIs (OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/Mistral), function/tool calling, streaming, and robust output handling.
* **Evaluation Mindset:** Ability to define measurable success, create labeled datasets, and run methodical experiments/A/B tests.
* **Product Sense:** Comfortable talking with customers, turning qualitative feedback into shipped improvements.
* **Data Hygiene:** Practical experience cleaning, labeling, and balancing datasets; awareness of privacy/PII constraints.

**Nice\-to\-Haves**
-------------------

* Experience building **prompt\-authoring UIs/SDKs** or internal tooling for prompt versioning and governance.
* **Agentic frameworks \& tooling:** DSpy, MCP, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Rasa; experience with agent/tool schemas and orchestration.
* **Observability \& eval tooling:** Langfuse, LangSmith, Braintrust; building eval harnesses and experiment dashboards.
* **RAG \& vector stores:** Qdrant/Weaviate/Pinecone and retrieval\-aware prompting.
* **Experimentation workflows:** A/B testing, prompt diffing/versioning.
* **Infra \& analytics:** light SQL/log analysis, metrics \& tracing, simple Grafana/OTel dashboards.
* Writing public **blog posts** or talks about applied LLM techniques.

**Interview Process**
---------------------

* **30\-min intro screen** – background, role fit, questions both ways.
* **Practical exercise (Prompt \+ Python)** – design a prompt strategy, a customer\-facing co\-pilot flow, and a small eval harness.
* **Team interviews** – deep dive on product mindset, experimentation rigor, and collaboration.
* **Founder/Leadership chat** – scope, impact, and ways of working.

**Why Join**
------------

* Own the **reasoning layer** and the **customer co\-pilot experience** used at scale.
* Ship fast in a **tight customer feedback loop** and see your impact measured in days, not quarters.

  

Founded in Berlin in 2023 by serial entrepreneurs Albert Astabatsyan, Hakob Astabatsyan, and Sassun Mirzakhan\-Saky, Synthflow AI democratizes access to advanced voice AI with a no\-code platform that lets **enterprises easily create, deploy and scale** natural\-sounding, cost\-effective voice agents tailored to their business needs.

Shape the future of satellite imagery with AI\-driven innovation.


#### **Who we are**



SATLANTIS designs and manufactures very high\-resolution optical payloads (iSIM family) for small satellites, enabling complete end\-to\-end Earth Observation missions. We operate at the forefront of imaging, onboard processing, and applied research for critical domains including environmental monitoring, energy, defense, and agriculture.



We are seeking a talented AI Engineer to join our Engineering team in Leioa (Bizakaia, Spain). You will work on cutting\-edge technology in satellite image processing and onboard intelligence through research, development, and deployment of AI/ML algorithms.



If you’re passionate about space, AI, and Earth observation, this is your launchpad!


#### **What’s in it for you?**


* **Mission\-driven innovation:** Apply AI to space technology that tackles climate, energy, and global challenges.
* **Flexible working hours:** Work\-life balance starts with trust in how you manage your time.
* **Young, proactive, and dynamic environment:** Join a collaborative team where autonomy and innovation are part of our daily mindset.
* **Private health insurance:** Your wellbeing comes first—with top\-tier medical coverage.
* **Office perks:** Enjoy fresh fruit, quality coffee, and an energizing work atmosphere.
* **Discounts at campus facilities:** Get access to local restaurants and sports installations on the UPV/EHU campus.
* **International exposure:** Collaborate with ESA, NASA, and research institutions worldwide.

#### **Your mission**



As an AI Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize machine learning models and data pipelines that empower satellite operations and image processing. You’ll work alongside experts working in multi\-disciplinary fields including satellites, space operations, image processing, data pipeline and geospatial analytics to co\-develop AI solutions that extract actionable insights from SATLANTIS’s high\-resolution imagery.



This is a full\-stack applied AI role: from ground\-based pipelines for advanced image processing to lightweight onboard models optimized for in\-orbit inference.



You’ll play a central role in scaling SATLANTIS’s AI capabilities across missions, shaping the future of next\-generation missions from space.


#### **Your main responsibilities will include:**


* Building AI pipelines for the ground segment—training and deploying deep learning models for super resolution, atmospheric correction, methane detection, crop and forestry classification, and more.
* Designing scalable workflows, automating data ingest, tiling, and inference on both on\-prem and cloud environments (Docker/K8s).
* Validating performance, benchmarking PSNR/SSIM against simulated and in\-orbit data, and creating continuous test dashboards.
* Porting lightweight models for in\-orbit demonstrations, optimizing to ONNX/TensorRT when missions require it.
* Collaborating with Image Processing, Flight Software, and Systems Engineering teams for end\-to\-end product delivery.
* Sharing knowledge through code reviews, workshops, and SATLANTIS School sessions for interns.

#### **What will set you up for success?**


* You hold a BSc/MSc in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace, Physics, or similar fields—providing a solid foundation for AI in space.
* You have up to three years of experience designing and deploying ML models in production or scientific workflows.
* You are proficient in DL frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, TensorRT).
* You feel comfortable working with CI/CD tools.
* You have a strong understanding of model evaluation, generalization, and uncertainty estimation.
* You are familiar with geospatial libraries: Rasterio, Xarray, GDAL, etc.
* You have an English level of at least B2, allowing you to contribute to international projects with ESA and NASA.

#### **You’ll stand out even more if you bring:**


* Skills in C \& C\+\+ programming and GNU/Linux OS.
* Experience with imaging algorithms and spatiotemporal models.
* Knowledge of satellite EO data formats (GeoTIFF, NetCDF).
* Hands\-on expertise with CUDA/C\+\+ for servers and embedded GPUs.
* Knowledge of radiometry, photogrammetry, or OGC APIs \& STAC metadata.
* Contribution to open\-source ML or EO projects


**Ready to launch your AI career into orbit?**



If you’re passionate about AI, space missions, and turning data into actionable insights for Earth observation—this is your opportunity.



Apply now and join SATLANTIS in shaping the future of space technology.

title: AI Engineer (Platform)
description:
We are looking for an AI Engineer to join nPlan's Engineering team.


We work with complex graph data (each with 10,000\+ nodes), applying multiple ML and LLM approaches to understanding the data, extracting meaningful insights from it using a proprietary forecasting engine, and empowering deep human interactions \- all of which must work efficiently and robustly in production. As a startup, we also keep agile in a fast\-moving environment!  

  

With this technology, nPlan are creating first\-of\-its\-kind products, that can significantly improve the planning and delivery of major construction projects.  

So if you want your work to make a real difference to the world around you, then we would love to tell you more about this role at nPlan


This is a new role, which will work closely with


* the team's existing backend and frontend engineers (helping harden shared best practice for AI integrations),
* the adjacent nPlan Experimental Research Division (nERD), and its AI Engineer, particularly as the underlying technologies evolve over time,
* the Product organisation, making sure your new features are giving our customers what they want and need.


It is a remote\-first role. We have a London office, and occasional travel will be required for company offsites and to collaborate with the rest of the team in person. If you are based in London, you can use the office as frequently as you like.

  

**Summary**
===========


* Join our Engineering team, prototyping and productizing new AI features that change the way construction projects are managed via our product.
* We are a very fast\-growing Series A startup with investors including GV (formerly known as Google Ventures) and Demis Hassabis (founder of DeepMind).
* Base salary of £70k\-100k depending on experience, along with equity package.
* Flexible working hours \& locations \- so long as you can do our core hours of 11am\-3pm (UK timezone), Mon\-Fri, we're happy.
* Enhanced benefits package including (for example) private medical insurance, unlimited holiday allowance, and enhanced family and sick leave policies.


**About nPlan**
===============


Our purpose is to inspire the world to forecast correctly and empower it to tackle risk, powered by our deep learning technology and its unique ability to forecast the outcomes of construction projects. We're on a mission to change how construction projects are planned, managed and executed, and in the process unlock a trillion dollars of new project value for the world through our data\-driven forecasting.  

  

We're lucky to work on some of the largest infrastructure projects in the world, which gives us both an opportunity and a privilege to make a significant impact on the world around us, and what it will look like in the future, every day.  

  

You'll be joining a world class and well funded team, backed by top investors including GV (formerly known as Google Ventures) that all believe in the future we are creating. We've been on a tremendous growth trajectory, and we've got very ambitious growth plans for 2025 and beyond.

  

**What you'll do in this role**
===============================


* Prototype, implement and help support new applications of AI for the construction domain, pushing the boundaries of what's possible.
* Build core infrastructure that allows us to build and ship LLM apps quickly \- this includes observability, how we work with several LLM providers \+ our own fine tuned models.
* Work with other engineers in the product and research teams to bring new models and applications to production.
* Be a leader in best practices and implementing AI across the whole company, keeping up to date with latest advancements and how they impact nPlan.
* Ideate and implement new features and functionality, and maintain LLM pipelines for both real time inference and development.


**About you**
=============


You love to build products in a fast\-paced environment with a super high degree of autonomy


* You keep up to date with the latest developments in AI and love to experiment with new models
* You have shipped LLM and generative AI based applications to production
* You have experience with LLM evaluation and the development lifecycle of LLM features
* You are really comfortable working with Python and building APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI or Django
* Please mention the word ‘crane' in your application.


**Nice\-to\-haves:**
====================


* Familiarity with Python, Go, Typescript
* You have experience working with Google Cloud, and/or Kubernetes/Docker


**What working at nPlan will be like**
======================================


* We are still a relatively small team so there is plenty of opportunity for a high degree of ownership over different areas of the product, and you will be directly exposed to all areas of the business.
* Your voice will always be heard. What you do or say counts, not who you are or where you're from.
* We have three core values that underlie everything we do: Learn from Everything, Be Radically Truthful, and Aim High, Run Fast. These enable us to create a collaborative, inclusive environment where we can move effectively and efficiently to implement the best solutions.

* Fantastic benefits package for Health \& Wellbeing, Learning \& Development, family leave, team meals and more.
* We are committed to addressing the diversity problem in the tech industry, and that starts with making sure we have a diverse team where everyone feels at home and can contribute as an equal.
* Having time to yourself and a private life is important. We offer a very flexible work environment and a generous holiday policy.

  

  

*We are working hard to create a workplace that is inclusive to everyone, no matter their background, or where they are in life. We believe that only a truly diverse place can create great products that serve a wide audience and improve the world.*  

  

*We believe in equality of opportunities and that's why we make sure that these ideas are reflected in our values, and that we really apply these in all aspects of our company culture.*  

*If you have a need for any adjustments during our interview process, let us know and we will do our best to accommodate them.*

title: Machine Learning Engineer, International Public Sector
description:
Scale’s rapidly growing International Public Sector team is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. Our core work consists of:
   

  

* Creating custom AI applications that will impact millions of citizens
* Generating high\-quality training data for national LLMs
* Upskilling and advisory services to spread the impact of AI


 We are hiring multiple Machine Learning Engineers who will leverage the latest research to design, train, deploy, and evaluate computer vision and/or language models to power the custom applications we build for our public sector clients.
   

  

 At Scale, we’re not just building AI solutions—we’re enabling the public sector to transform their operations and better serve citizens through cutting\-edge technology. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI in the public sector and be a founding member of our team, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**You will:**
* Partner with public sector counterparts to deeply understand their challenges
* Apply the latest research as you design custom models or chains of models
* Collaborate closely with our data annotation teams to create high\-quality training datasets
* Train, optimize, and deploy models into challenging production environments
* Develop and maintain robust evaluation systems
* Participate in customer engagements, including occasional travel (approximately one week per quarter)
* Contribute to the scaling of AI capabilities in the public sector through hands\-on knowledge sharing


**Ideally, you’d have:**
* 5\+ years of computer vision and/or language model training, deployment, evaluation, and maintenance experience in a production environment
* Master’s or equivalent work experience

* Provide technical mentorship to ML engineers, raising the bar for applied delivery and model deployment.
* Flex into data science tasks when needed: feature engineering, model experimentation, and analytical insights, reflecting the versatility required in a fast\-moving team.

* 8\+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying ML systems in production.
* Proven track record of leading ML engineering projects from prototype to production delivery.
* Deep expertise in modern ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX, Ray, MLflow, Kubeflow).
* Proficiency in Python and at least one backend language (e.g., Java, Scala, Go, C\+\+).
* Strong knowledge of cloud ML infrastructure (AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, Azure ML) and containerized deployments (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Hands\-on experience with ML pipelines, distributed training, and inference scaling.
* Familiarity with monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog).
* Experience in regulated industries (finance, insurance, healthcare) with compliance and governance needs.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to mentor others and influence technical direction.
* Working knowledge of data science techniques (e.g., supervised/unsupervised ML, model evaluation, causal inference, feature engineering).
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related technical field (PhD a plus).

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience integrating with Palantir platforms (Foundry, AIP, Ontology) as a user/consumer.
* Practical exposure to LLM and GenAI delivery (fine\-tuning, RAG, vector search, inference).
* Experience optimizing GPU clusters or distributed training workloads.
* Familiarity with graph databases (Neo4j, TigerGraph) in applied ML contexts.

**Benefits**

* Work at the forefront of AI/ML innovation in life insurance, annuities, and financial services.
* Drive AI transformation for some of the most sophisticated financial entities.

Competitive compensation, benefits, future equity options, and leadership opportunities.  
*

description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self\-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes.  The Simulator team builds state\-of\-the\-art simulations of realistic environments for the testing and training of the Waymo driver. We use machine learning to model the real world, including realistic agents (vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists, motorcyclists etc.), roads, traffic control systems, and weather. * Be part of a world class research engineering team to grow the state\-of\-the\-art of ultra realistic AV simulations using foundation models
* Collaborate with teams in London, Oxford and Mountain View and to use large models to improve sim realism
* Design experiments that push the frontiers of AV simulations

* Train and evaluate large models and integrate them into the simulator and its downstream applications
* Help hire outstanding research engineers from diverse backgrounds
* Be a part of a collaborative research engineering team that takes research ideas and productionizes them

**The Role**
 As a Principal Machine Learning Engineer (UK), you will be embedded in the UK Data Science team and play a critical role in accelerating delivery of AI solutions. Reporting to the Head of the UK AI \& Data Science team, you will work alongside Data Scientists to take prototypes and translate them into reliable, production\-ready services for business stakeholders.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on technical leadership role: you will set direction, architect solutions, and mentor peers. The remit is squarely focused on last\-mile delivery — taking prototypes built by Data Scientists and making them usable in real business settings by packaging them into services or APIs, wiring them into data sources, building lightweight feature and inference pipelines, and adding basic monitoring and retraining logic. You will accelerate pilot deployments so stakeholders can see value quickly, and then hand the solution off to the Central Engineering and Data team, who are responsible for firm\-wide platforms, scaling, and long\-term support.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will also bring applied data science skills and be comfortable moving between ML engineering and data science work. You should be able to contribute to model development and analysis when needed, in addition to owning deployment and operationalization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Translate data science prototypes into production\-ready pilot ML services tailored to business use cases.
* Build lightweight pipelines (feature engineering, model packaging, inference services) that integrate smoothly with central platforms while meeting immediate delivery needs.
* Champion pragmatic MLOps practices (CI/CD for ML, monitoring, observability) to improve reliability without duplicating central engineering’s enterprise frameworks.
* Partner closely with Data Scientists to operationalize models, and collaborate with central engineering to plan handoffs of successful pilots for hardening and scale.
* Apply emerging ML engineering techniques (LLM deployment, RAG, vector databases) to accelerate delivery of applied projects.
* Develop reusable components and lessons learned that central teams can adopt into firm\-wide platforms.
* Ensure ML workflows comply with governance, audit, and regulatory requirements.
* Collaborate with central Engineering, Data, Product, and Security teams to ensure alignment with firm\-wide platforms and standards.
* Provide technical mentorship to ML engineers, raising the bar for applied delivery and model deployment.
* Flex into data science tasks when needed: feature engineering, model experimentation, and analytical insights, reflecting the versatility required in a fast\-moving team.


**Requirements**
* 8\+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying ML systems in production.
* Proven track record of leading ML engineering projects from prototype to production delivery.
* Deep expertise in modern ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX, Ray, MLflow, Kubeflow).
* Proficiency in Python and at least one backend language (e.g., Java, Scala, Go, C\+\+).
* Strong knowledge of cloud ML infrastructure (AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, Azure ML) and containerized deployments (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Hands\-on experience with ML pipelines, distributed training, and inference scaling.
* Familiarity with monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog).
* Experience in regulated industries (finance, insurance, healthcare) with compliance and governance needs.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to mentor others and influence technical direction.
* Working knowledge of data science techniques (e.g., supervised/unsupervised ML, model evaluation, causal inference, feature engineering).
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related technical field (PhD a plus).


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience integrating with Palantir platforms (Foundry, AIP, Ontology) as a user/consumer.
* Practical exposure to LLM and GenAI delivery (fine\-tuning, RAG, vector search, inference).
* Experience optimizing GPU clusters or distributed training workloads.
* Familiarity with graph databases (Neo4j, TigerGraph) in applied ML contexts.


**Benefits**
* Work at the forefront of AI/ML innovation in life insurance, annuities, and financial services.
* Drive AI transformation for some of the most sophisticated financial entities.
* Competitive compensation, benefits, future equity options, and leadership opportunities.


 This is a hybrid position based in the United Kingdom.
   

  

 We offer a competitive base pay \+ a discretionary bonus will be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits.
